newsitem.title: USA: Regal tenders for 10-5/8 pct senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Regal tenders for 10-5/8 pct senior notes.

text.p: Regal Cinemas Inc said Thursday it made a tender offer for all its outstanding 10-5/8 percent Senior Secured Notes due 2003, totaling $85 million aggregate principal.
The company said it set a consent solicitation in order to effect certain changes to the indenture relating to the Notes.
In connection with the tender offer, Regal recognizes one-time charges totaling of about $9.1 million (net of tax) in its current quarter ending October 2, it said.
Regal said the Notes are set to a fixed spread of 65 basis points over the yield to maturity of the United States Treasury 7-1/8 percent Notes due February 29, 2000.
The Notes were formerly the obligation of Cobb Theatres LLC, it said.
